question_or_proposition: From what date are Whole Effluent Toxicity monitoring and reporting requirements under Part I first applicable, and how do Part II whole-effluent-toxicity provisions—including any additional conditions and the referenced frequency-reduction option—modify or supplement those requirements?
notes: Footnote *9 is attached to the Part I WET monitoring row and states that monitoring and reporting begin on the permit effective date while deferring further WET conditions to Part II. Resolving the commencement date and any Part II modifications is needed to determine whether WET monitoring was required for a given period (Purpose B) and how to classify absent WET results (Purpose C). The passage does not establish numeric effluent limits for WET (values are report-only), so Purpose A is not materially affected.
